  • Method Details

    • amount

      public TradeSetProviderBase.TradeSetBuilder amount(int amount)
      Sets the exact amount of trades to pick from the pool. Defaults to 2.

    • amount

      public TradeSetProviderBase.TradeSetBuilder amount(int min, int max)
      Sets the amount of trades to pick from the pool to a uniformly distributed random value.

    • amount

      public TradeSetProviderBase.TradeSetBuilder amount(net.minecraft.world.level.storage.loot.providers.number.NumberProvider amount)
      Sets the amount of trades to pick from the pool.

    • allowDuplicates

      public TradeSetProviderBase.TradeSetBuilder allowDuplicates()
      Allows the same trade to be picked multiple times. By default, each trade is picked at most once, which also caps the effective amount at the size of the pool.

    • randomSequence

      public TradeSetProviderBase.TradeSetBuilder randomSequence(net.minecraft.resources.Identifier randomSequence)
      Sets the random sequence used to pick the trades. Trade sets sharing a sequence produce the same results for the same world seed. Vanilla uses the id of the trade set prefixed with trade_set/ here.

    • build

      public net.minecraft.core.Holder<net.minecraft.world.item.trading.TradeSet> build()
      Builds the TradeSet. This method returns an intrusive holder that must be properly added to the registry. RegistryProviderBase does this automatically if the result is stored in a public, non-static field inside the provider.
